item.title: [Graph: New permission] Policy.ReadWrite.AuthFeatureToggle
item.description:

Microsoft publishes it as “Read and write feature toggle policy” (Application) and “Read and write your organization's feature toggle policy” (DelegatedWork), admin consent required, privilege level 4, on GET and PATCH /policies/authenticationfeaturetogglepolicy. Not yet on the public permissions reference.

item.title: [New] Two new Graph permissions read and write the Entra authentication feature toggle policy: Policy.Read.AuthFeatureToggle and Policy.ReadWrite.AuthFeatureToggle (privilege level 4)
item.description:
An app granted the ReadWrite permission can PATCH a tenant-wide authentication policy without a signed-in user; it is a new consent string that existing app-consent reviews and alert rules do not know.

Graph · Add both names to the watch list of app-consent and service-principal permission alerts, and treat any grant of Policy.ReadWrite.AuthFeatureToggle as a tier-0 change.

item.title: [New] SharePoint Online blocks new classic publishing sites and publishing features from 1 March 2027; new tenants also lose classic pages and custom scripts
item.description:
Custom scripting and classic pages are a long-standing persistence and phishing surface in SharePoint; Microsoft closing them is a hardening win, but provisioning automation that still creates publishing sites will fail.

SharePoint · Before 28 February 2027 find provisioning scripts and migrations that create classic publishing sites or activate publishing features, move them to modern sites, and inventory classic pages with the Microsoft 365 Assessment Tool.

item.title: [New] Intune Data Warehouse policy-status collections move to the new reporting infrastructure from 4 January 2027; counts may change
item.description:
Compliance dashboards built on Data Warehouse can show a step change in compliant or failing device counts that is a reporting change, not a security event.

Intune · Note the date in any compliance or Conditional Access readiness report built on these collections so a jump in counts after 4 January is not chased as an incident.

item.title: [Due in 6 days] Defender for Identity retires two classic alerts at the end of November: Remote code execution attempt and Suspected identity theft (pass-the-hash)
item.description:
Two identity-attack detections disappear from the SOC queue; any analytics rule, playbook or SLA keyed on their alert titles goes silent, and pass-the-hash on hosts without MDE is no longer alerted at all.

MDI · deadline 2026-11-30 · Before 30 November create the Advanced Hunting custom detection from Microsoft's RemoteCodeExecution query, confirm MDE covers every DC and tier-0 host for pass-the-hash, and repoint Sentinel rules and playbooks that match the two classic alert names.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Due in 7 days] Exchange Online Admin API v2.0 drops Exchange.ManageV2 and Exchange.ManageAsAppV2 on 1 December; apps must move to Exchange.AdminAPI.Manage / .ManageAsApp and get fresh admin consent
item.description:
Every automation and third-party tool that administers Exchange through the Admin API needs a new consent grant this month; a rushed tenant-wide consent on an app-only Exchange administration permission is exactly the grant an attacker hopes to slip through, and a missed one breaks the tool on 1 December.

Exchange Online · deadline 2026-12-01 · Inventory service principals holding Exchange.ManageV2 or Exchange.ManageAsAppV2, grant the replacement only to apps you still need, verify their Exchange RBAC role, test, then remove the old permission before 1 December; alert on consent to Exchange.AdminAPI.ManageAsApp in AuditLogs.

item.title: [Due in 3 days] SharePoint mobile apps for iOS and Android stop reaching SharePoint Server on 27 November 2026 and support SharePoint Online only
item.description:
Users who lose app access to on-premises SharePoint tend to fall back to the mobile browser or unmanaged apps, which may sit outside the app-protection policies that covered the SharePoint app.

SharePoint · deadline 2026-11-27 · Notify users who reach SharePoint Server from the mobile apps, update support documentation, and check that the browser path is covered by the same access and app-protection policies.

item.title: [Due in 6 days] Outlook's Join button stops appearing for meetings whose join URL is HTTP-only, from the week of 30 November 2026
item.description:
An HTTP-only meeting link is a cleartext redirect target; dropping the button removes one click path to it, and an integration still emitting HTTP links is worth finding.

Exchange Online · deadline 2026-11-30 · Ask owners of third-party meeting providers, add-ins and custom integrations to confirm they emit HTTPS join URLs, and validate new invitations before 30 November 2026.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Bring Your Own Telephony (BYOT) is now generally available beside CYOT; Microsoft-provided SMS and voice still start retiring on 1 February 2027
item.description:
The telephony integration becomes a tier-0 component in an Azure subscription: whoever can change it controls MFA code delivery, and SMS pumping fraud is billed to the tenant.

Entra · Decide which users truly need SMS or voice, move everyone else to passkeys, and if a provider is needed lock down the Azure subscription hosting the integration (RBAC, activity-log alerts) before 1 February 2027.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Due in 6 days] App Builder agent and vibe.powerapps.com retire on 30 November 2026; new app creation stops mid-October
item.description:
Apps built by makers in these two experiences hold data connections; migrating them into Copilot Studio or Copilot Cowork changes where they run and who owns them, and an app that is not migrated silently stops being reachable.

Power Platform · deadline 2026-11-30 · Identify makers using App Builder or vibe.powerapps.com, tell them about the 30 November date, and review the migrated apps' connections and sharing in Copilot Studio as they move.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Due in 7 days] Security Operator loses default access to email threat policies and the Tenant Allow/Block List under Defender Unified RBAC, now from early December
item.description:
Adding a block entry to the Tenant Allow/Block List is a routine containment step in a phishing incident. An analyst who holds only Security Operator will find that step denied mid-incident some day in November, with no error that names this change.

Defender XDR · deadline 2026-12-01 · List who holds Entra Security Operator and uses it for email threat policies or the Tenant Allow/Block List; before November assign those people the Unified RBAC permissions Core security settings and Detection tuning, or a role that includes them, and test a block entry with a Security Operator-only account.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Due in 7 days] App Governance permissions change for three Entra roles as Defender XDR Unified RBAC takes over
item.description:
Two compliance roles silently lose an app-governance capability and one security role gains it: an app-governance policy nobody can edit, or one an unexpected role can now edit, is a control gap either way.

Defender XDR · deadline 2026-12-01 · Before early December, list who reaches App Governance through Compliance Administrator, Compliance Data Administrator or Cloud App Security Administrator, review custom Defender XDR Unified RBAC roles for Defender for Cloud Apps, and reassign affected people to a supported Entra role or a custom Unified RBAC role on least privilege.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Due in 6 days] Entra switches off unused or failing SMS first-factor sign-in tenant by tenant; the rollout now runs to the end of November 2026
item.description:
SMS first-factor sign-in skips MFA and Microsoft cites significant fraud against it; tenants that still use it can lose it for frontline users at any point until the end of November, and tenants that do not use it keep a phishable path enabled until Microsoft clears it.

Entra · deadline 2026-11-30 · Review SMS first-factor sign-ins (SignInNoPassword) for the last 30 days, give every SMS-only user another method, and clear 'Use for sign-in' yourself if nobody needs it.

item.title: [New] SyntheticMediaDetectionEvents: a new advanced hunting table records deepfake (synthetic media) detections in Microsoft Teams calls and meetings
item.description:
Voice and video impersonation of executives and help-desk staff is the social-engineering path behind several recent intrusions; this is the first table that records it as data a SOC can hunt and alert on.

Defender XDR · If a detection engine is approved, add a custom detection on IsMalicious == true joined to CallActivityEvents, and route it to the team that handles payment-fraud and help-desk verification.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Custom detection rules map up to four identifiers per entity and the same entity type more than once (preview from 17 November 2026)
item.description:
Richer entity mapping is what correlation, automatic attack disruption and the new alert grouping key on; a rule that maps only one weak identifier groups and correlates badly.

Defender XDR · Review the custom detections that drive automated actions and add the stronger identifiers (object ID, SID, device ID) to their entities before turning on alert grouping.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Custom detection rules can group their own alerts into one incident by time frame and matching entities (preview from 17 November 2026)
item.description:
Grouping changes how many incidents a noisy rule opens and how the queue reads; a rule set to 'group all alerts into one incident' can fold an unrelated second intrusion into an incident an analyst already triaged, and a closed incident is never reopened, so a matching alert lands in a new one.

Defender XDR · Leave grouping off on high-severity rules until tested; for noisy rules, choose 'all entities match' rather than 'group all', and document the time frame so the SOC knows why an incident holds many alerts.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Defender portal navigation reorganised in preview: Microsoft Sentinel pages move out of their own section into the areas where they are used
item.description:
Runbooks and analyst training that say 'Microsoft Sentinel > ...' stop matching the portal for users who get the new navigation; nothing changes in permissions or data.

Defender XDR · Check which navigation your analysts see and update runbook paths and onboarding material for the moved Sentinel pages.

A summary over a whole channel surfaces old posts a member never scrolled to, including credentials or incident details pasted months ago; the exposure is what the member could already read, made easy to find.

Teams · Before the preview reaches users, review which large or shared channels hold sensitive history, and baseline CopilotInteraction records whose context is a Teams channel.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra roll out across Microsoft Copilot; Astra is available only where the tenant enables the OpenAI subprocessor
item.description:
Which model processes a prompt is a data-processing question: a tenant that enabled the OpenAI subprocessor for one feature now routes Copilot prompts in Office apps to it as well, and the audit record (ModelTransparencyDetails) is the only place that shows it.

Copilot · Confirm whether the OpenAI subprocessor is enabled in the Microsoft 365 admin center and that the decision is recorded; watch CopilotInteraction audit records for the model provider.

item.title: [New] Entra blog explains how macOS Platform SSO works with Entra ID: device trust, sign-in prompts and access controls
item.description:
Platform SSO changes where a Mac's primary refresh token is created and stored; knowing which sign-ins come from a Platform SSO-registered Mac is what lets Conditional Access require a compliant device on macOS.

Entra · Use the post to check that Macs signing in are Entra-joined through Platform SSO and that Conditional Access requires a compliant device for macOS.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Azure Firewall for Containers enters public preview: Azure Firewall policy applied to containerized workloads
item.description:
Egress filtering for containers has usually lived in the cluster; a firewall logging to the same AZFW tables as the rest of Azure lets the SOC hunt container egress with existing queries.

Azure · Treat as preview: pilot on a non-production cluster and confirm its logs reach the resource-specific AZFW tables before relying on it for detection.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Microsoft 365 Copilot app turns on a new search experience by default for users without a Copilot licence, from late November 2026
item.description:
Better search surfaces whatever users can already open, including overshared files and connected third-party sources: oversharing becomes easier to find, not new.

Copilot · Tell the help desk about the toggle back to classic search, and review oversharing reports for sites and connectors users will now find more easily.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Outlook for iOS, Android and Mac move Contact Support under the new Outlook cloud policy; tenants that disabled it must redeploy the policy
item.description:
A support chat inside the mail client is a channel users trust; tenants that switched it off for data-handling reasons will see it come back on mobile and Mac unless the policy is redeployed.

Exchange Online · If you disabled Contact Support in new Outlook, redeploy that Cloud Policy once the updated version appears in OCPS so it also covers iOS, Android and Mac.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Copilot desktop app can sync passwords, personal info, settings and browsing history with Microsoft Edge, opt-in by the user, from mid-December 2026
item.description:
Saved passwords leave the browser you govern and land in a second app: a token or session theft on the Copilot app now reaches the same credential store, and Edge sync policies you set may not cover the new path until Microsoft publishes its control.

Copilot · Before mid-December, check whether your Edge sync policies (SyncDisabled, SyncTypesListDisabled, password manager settings) apply to the Copilot desktop app once Microsoft documents it, and decide whether password sync is allowed.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Copilot Studio can create Dataverse agent users backed by Microsoft Entra agent identities, generally available 8 December 2026
item.description:
Each such agent becomes a directory identity with Dataverse data access; agent identities need the same inventory, role review and sign-in monitoring as service principals.

Copilot Studio · Inventory Entra agent identities created from Copilot Studio after 8 December, review the Dataverse security roles they get, and include them in access reviews.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Teams meeting policy gains "Who can record and transcribe": admins can stop presenters from recording and lock the choice, from mid-December 2026
item.description:
Recordings and transcripts are data that leaves the meeting; restricting who can start them is a data-loss control, and the precedence order (label, then locked policy, then template) decides what is actually enforced.

Teams · Decide whether sensitive user groups need the locked "organizers and co-organizers" option, and check label and template precedence before assigning the policy.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Copilot desktop app opens websites shared in chat inside the app by default from January 2027; the BrowsingEnabled policy turns it off
item.description:
An embedded browser is a second browser on the endpoint: web filtering, SmartScreen, downloads and session controls applied to Edge may not cover it, so phishing links surfaced in Copilot chat open outside the controls you tuned.

Copilot · Decide before 3 January 2027 whether to set BrowsingEnabled to Off or configure the new in-app browsing policies (downloads, authentication, network) to match your Edge baseline.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] November 2026 non-security preview update for Windows 11 (KB5132057, KB5132265); there will be no December preview update
item.description:
Preview updates are where the following Patch Tuesday content is tested; the missing December preview shortens your test cycle for the January release, and the Secure Boot certificate restart can look like an unexplained reboot.

Windows · Pilot KB5132057 on test rings, and tell the SOC to expect one extra restart on devices receiving the Secure Boot certificate update.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Teams replaces the Copilot meeting policy with MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI; scripts using the old policy stop working, GA now January 2027
item.description:
"Copilot enforced off" is a governance control; scripts and baselines that set the Copilot policy will fail silently or return guidance once the new policies are on, leaving AI availability different from what the baseline says.

Teams · Find every script, DSC or baseline that sets the Teams Copilot meeting policy and move it to MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI before January 2027; verify the mapped values afterwards.

item.title: [New] Windows at Ignite: IAKerb lets Windows 11 use Kerberos without line of sight to a DC, Windows Hello event logs record Face, Fingerprint or PIN unlocks, web sign-in reaches hybrid joined devices
item.description:
IAKerb removes a common reason Windows clients fall back to NTLM, and the new Windows Hello events give the SOC a record of how a device was unlocked; remote lock is a containment action that keeps the evidence on the disk.

Windows · Plan IAKerb into the NTLM-retirement work (audit NTLM use first), decide where the Windows Hello event logs will be collected, and add remote lock to the lost-device and compromised-device playbooks.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Sentinel at Ignite: ISOC opt-in for Sentinel customers with E5, E7 or Defender Suite from 17 November; audit logs for automation rules and playbooks (preview); ingest-time normalization (preview, December)
item.description:
A record of who changed an automation rule or playbook closes a gap an intruder with Sentinel Contributor could use to silence response; ISOC opt-in changes retention and cost, and normalization at ingest changes what parsers your rules depend on.

Sentinel · Turn on and export the automation-rule and playbook audit records, alert on deactivation or deletion of automation rules, and model the ISOC opt-in against current retention before deciding.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Intune at Ignite: software compliance policy marks devices running unsanctioned AI agents noncompliant for Conditional Access (preview); container policies for agents; vulnerability remediation agent (limited preview)
item.description:
Unapproved AI agents on endpoints become something compliance can block, and the remediation agent can patch devices automatically, so change records and alert baselines must expect agent-initiated patching.

Intune · Inventory AI agents on Windows endpoints with Defender, decide which MSI product codes to mark noncompliant, and pilot the software compliance policy in report-only Conditional Access first.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Exchange Online sending from aliases is generally available: users can send and reply from any proxy address once the tenant switch is on
item.description:
Once enabled, outbound mail can carry any proxy address of a mailbox, including onmicrosoft.com addresses, so detections and transport rules keyed to the primary SMTP address miss mail a compromised account sends from an alias.

Exchange Online · Check whether SendFromAliasEnabled is on, set onmicrosoft.com domains to SendingFromDomainDisabled, and review transport and journaling rules and sender-based detections for alias addresses.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Unified app and agent installation management is generally available: installs set in the Microsoft 365 or Teams admin center now sync to the other within 24-48 hours
item.description:
Which apps and agents are pushed to users is now decided in one place for Teams, Outlook and Microsoft 365 Copilot; an install policy changed in one admin center reaches the other without a second review.

M365 admin · Review installed-by-admin apps and agents in the Microsoft 365 admin center after unification, and restrict who holds the roles that can deploy agents.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Microsoft 365 Backup full workload backup: general availability slips from September-October 2026 to January-February 2027
item.description:
Ransomware recovery plans that counted on whole-workload backup at GA this autumn are three to four months early; until then only custom policies cover new sites and mailboxes.

M365 admin · Keep custom backup policies covering new sites and mailboxes until the GA lands, and move any recovery-plan dependency on full workload backup to Q1 2027.

item.title: [New] Microsoft research: device-code phishing reaches AI coding agents — a stolen GitHub sign-in lets an attacker drive GitHub Copilot CLI
item.description:
Device code flow is a live phishing technique against Entra and now against developer agents that run with the developer's own rights; most tenants still allow it for everyone.

Threat Intel · Block the device code flow in Conditional Access (Authentication flows condition) for everyone who does not need it, and hunt for device-code sign-ins from unexpected locations in SigninLogs / AADSignInEventsBeta.

item.title: [New] Entra at Ignite: passkeys become the default for new accounts; PIM gains PIM-only mode, app roles and agents (preview); Conditional Access policy plans (preview); guest lifecycle policies GA
item.description:
PIM-only mode and PIM for app roles touch tier-0 assignment paths; CA policy plans change how policies are authored and audited; guest lifecycle policies can disable guests automatically.

Entra · Read the PIM-only mode and CA policy plan docs before enabling either; for guest lifecycle policies, run the built-in report in report mode first and warn sponsors.

item.title: [New] Hunt DCSync-style replication, GPO updates, LDAP searches and Kerberos binds in the identity tables of advanced hunting
item.description:
DRSR replication requests from a non-DC are the DCSync signal; until now they needed a custom detection outside these tables.

Defender XDR · Add a hunting query on IdentityDirectoryEvents for DRSR events whose source device is not a domain controller, and review existing LDAP reconnaissance detections against the new IdentityQueryEvents rows.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Defender at Ignite: integrated SOC case management, playbooks, workbooks and UEBA are GA; vulnerability shielding (preview) is on by default
item.description:
Vulnerability shielding is on by default and acts on its own during an attack, so the SOC will see protections and alerts it did not configure; ISOC GA changes where Sentinel cases and playbooks live.

Defender XDR · Find where vulnerability shielding actions are logged and audited before the first autonomous action lands; decide whether existing Sentinel workspaces opt into ISOC and test playbooks there.

item.title: [New] Azure Baseline Security Mode (preview): a guided way to apply and keep baseline security settings across subscriptions
item.description:

item.title: [New] App Governance moves to Defender XDR unified RBAC (preview late November, GA from mid-December): existing Defender for Cloud Apps roles may gain App Governance access
item.description:

MDA · Before GA, list who holds Defender for Cloud Apps unified RBAC roles and confirm the App Governance permissions they will inherit; keep Service management (turn the service off) in a dedicated role.

item.title: [New] High-volume phishing uses fake Microsoft 365 outage notices ("emails held, deleted in 24 hours") to harvest credentials across sectors
item.description:
A lure that imitates the admin-center service-health voice reaches every mailbox, and users are primed by real outages; a harvested password without phishing-resistant MFA is an account takeover.

Threat Intel · Run Microsoft's EmailEvents, EmailUrlInfo and UrlClickEvents queries for the listed domains and subject pattern over the last 7 days, purge matches with ZAP or Threat Explorer, and reset passwords and revoke sessions for any user who clicked.

item.description:

Intune · Limit the Intune roles that can create or assign PowerShell scripts, and alert on new script assignments to All Devices or All Users in Intune audit logs.

item.title: [New] Reject Direct Send is generally available: one org setting rejects unauthenticated mail that spoofs your own domains; new tenants get it on by default
item.description:
Direct Send is the path phishing kits use to deliver mail that looks internal and skips SPF alignment checks on the From header; this setting closes it for your own domains.

Exchange Online · Read the Change Optics Report, create partner inbound connectors for scanners and apps that send as your domain, then run Set-OrganizationConfig -RejectDirectSend $true and watch NDRs with 5.7.68 for a week.
